descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Noncompliant Models
  description: Lists the oldest 10 managed devices and summarizes compliance by model.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Retrieves managed devices with compliance information.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count devices by compliance state
    detail: Counts devices per complianceState bucket.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown
  - id: sort_by_last_sync
    format: transform
    label: Sort devices by last sync
    detail: Orders devices by lastSyncDateTime ascending, taking the oldest 10.

      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings
    detail: Generates a short report of the oldest noncompliant devices.
